name: message-bubble
title: Message bubble
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Incoming or outgoing bubble, grouped, with sent, delivered, read, or a failed send that can be retried.

meta.descriptionEs: Burbuja entrante o saliente, agrupada, con enviado, entregado, leído o un envío fallido que se puede reintentar.

examples.title: Burbuja de mensaje
examples.description: Burbuja entrante o saliente, agrupada, con enviado, entregado, leído o un envío fallido que se puede reintentar.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y cantidad.

api.name: side
api.description: Incoming sits on the muted ground. Outgoing uses foreground ink.

api.name: delivery
api.description: The host passes deliveryLabel. failed shows retry.

api.name: grouped
api.description: Hides the repeated name. The avatar stays on the last incoming row.

api.name: enter
api.description: Fades and rises 8 px in 200 ms. Reduced motion skips it.
